sources.title: Anomaly constraints for heterotic strings and supergravity in six dimensions

evidence.text: Does cancellation of Dai-Freed anomalies impose additional consistency conditions on six-dimensional gravitational EFTs that pass local anomaly and charge-lattice constraints, particularly families with unbounded abelian charges?

sources.title: String Defects, Supersymmetry and the Swampland

evidence.text: What restrictions follow from anomaly inflow onto strings coupled to four-dimensional tensor fields, or their dual axions, in minimally supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric theories?

sources.title: String Defects, Supersymmetry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the supersymmetric J obstruction persist after Wilson lines and bulk displacement reduce the BSB gauge group to SO(16)×USp(16)?

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity

evidence.text: This compact example tests the proposed string conditions in a U(1)×SU(2) theory with nine fundamental hypermultiplets. Its magnetic charges are nonnegative integer combinations of H and H−E.

sources.title: Quantization of anomaly coefficients in 6D $\mathcal{N}=(1,0)$ supergravity

evidence.text: Which additional quantization conditions on 6D N=(1,0) supergravity anomaly coefficients follow from anomaly cancellation and string charge quantization, which require generalized completeness, and how does the global gauge group enter?

sources.title: Rational points in the 6d supergravity landscape and simple current extensions

evidence.text: Do five exotic anomaly-free T = 0 six-dimensional supergravity candidates satisfy stronger consistency tests from rational BPS-string worldsheets, and can their refined elliptic genera and global gauge groups be determined?

sources.title: Branes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a supergravity theory that passes bulk anomaly cancellation nevertheless fail because its required charged strings cannot support unitary worldsheet degrees of freedom?
